mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Aura: {{Spell_SonaE_Jade_Name}}</titleLeft><mainText>Sona is playing the Song of Celerity, increasing the movement speed of nearby allies.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Sona plays the Song of Celerity, granting nearby allied champions bonus Movement Speed. Additionally, casting this ability energizes nearby allies with a burst of speed.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Persistent Aura: Grants nearby allied Champions @MSBoost@ Move Speed.

Active: Grants nearby allied Champions @MoveSpeedMod*100@% Move Speed for @ActiveSpeedDuration@ seconds.
Sona's next {{ Spell_SonaPassive_Name }} enhanced attack will also <status>Slow</status> the target by @Spell.SonaE:TotalTempoMoveSpeedSlow@ for @Spell.SonaE:TempoDuration@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: After casting 3 spells, Sona's next attack deals bonus magic damage and causes her target to deal reduced damage for a few seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
After casting 3 spells, the next basic attack deals @PowerChordDamage@ bonus magic damage and causes her target to deal @DamageDebuff@% reduced damage for @DebuffDuration@ seconds.

Auras persist for @AuraPersistDuration@ seconds after deactivating.
